name: Lighthouse Fund
subtitle: All-or-nothing crowdfund
description: Example 12 — fixed goal and deadline: permissionless one-shot payout on success, self-claim refunds that erase contributor state on failure.
long_description: A single-purpose crowdfunding contract with no middle outcome. Contributors send native funds until the goal scalar is reached or the deadline passes. If the goal is met — even before the deadline — anyone may trigger the single payout to the fixed beneficiary; overfunding in the final contribution is accepted in full as a donation. If the deadline passes below the goal, every contributor self-claims an exact refund, and each refund deletes that contributor's slot: a failed campaign converges to zero permanent state, while a successful one keeps contributor slots as proof-of-origin treasury accounting. Goal, deadline, and beneficiary are immutable at deploy time — no key can change the rules of a running campaign.
